decided_by.quote: Your Course Examiner will tell you exactly how much GenAI, if any, you can use in each course and assessment item.
Each assessment item will include a Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) Usage statement.
There are three levels of GenAI usage:

duty.quote: Always acknowledge the use of GenAI tools, as you would with any source.

contents.quote: you must identify the GenAI tool used, describe how it was used, including the prompts utilised, and when it was used.
describe how it was used, including the prompts utilised

location.quote: Any use of GenAI tools must be clearly acknowledged in your assessment submission

referencing.quote: Acknowledge any use, or not, of GenAI in your assessment submission (follow the guidelines on Te Kete Wānaka's Referencing page).

consequence.quote: Using GenAI without following the guidelines is a breach of academic integrity.
